item.text: I found five polling stores. The helper currently has no stored callback or completion signal, and each store discards its poller, so none can wait for shutdown. I’m adding an idempotent, waitable `Close()` path and retaining the poller on each store; Git’s immutable hash mode will keep a nil poller and close as a no-op.

item.text: The stores now retain their poller, and `Poller.Close()` cancels its internal context and waits for the loop to finish; repeated closes are safe. I’ve formatted the changes and `git diff --check` is clean. Next I’m running the existing filesystem storage package tests.

item.text:
Implemented cancellable polling with a stored `UpdateFunc`. `Poller.Close()` cancels its context and waits for polling to stop. Git, local, Azure Blob, S3, and OCI snapshot stores now expose `Close()`; it is a no-op when no poller is active.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/storage/fs/...` and `git diff --check`.
